Cave Point has no dedicated cache page. Its short moment uses only the enclave and shoreline-trail relationship documented in 33.txt; dune descriptions refer explicitly to Whitefish Dunes. The current claim of wave-cut limestone ledges is unsupported and omitted. Its required title, at and motifs are retained.

The current claims of a calmer bay shore, quieter coves, a short drive and preferred seasons are not supported by the cache and are omitted.
